title: Retail Installment Contracts Fee Schedule Note: Extended-Deferral Review Charge
content:
**Note to the Retail Installment Contracts fee schedule.** A hardship extension carries an extended-deferral review charge set by the installments deferred by every earlier extension of the contract plus the installments the agreement defers:

| Earlier deferred plus this agreement's installments | Extended-deferral review charge |
|---|---|
| at least 4 | the fee adds 10.00 |
| exactly 3 | the fee adds 5.00 |
| fewer than 3 | nothing |

"Every earlier extension" means every extension already granted on the contract over its whole life, whenever it took effect.

**Hypothetical counts.** No earlier extension and an agreement deferring 2 installments: total 2, nothing added. One earlier extension of 1 installment and an agreement deferring 2: total 3, 5.00 added. Earlier extensions of 2 and 1 installments and an agreement deferring 1: total 4, 10.00 added. Earlier extensions totalling 5 and an agreement deferring 1: total 6, still 10.00.
